curated-gf-edu-vic-wa-nt-hand-pre-gf-tsu: Crayon-soft and low-slung, with a casual lean. Edu VIC WA NT Hand Pre earns its place big and short, while Tsukimi Rounded, with round forms like open parentheses, isn't built for lengthy paragraphs.
curated-gf-kapakana-gf-spectral-sc: Loose, graceful handwriting with letters that nearly melt together. Kapakana is at its best with low lowercase and closed letters; Spectral SC, a serif with sturdy hairlines and wide mouths, is suited to brief text.
